{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check the exact spelling of 'arm' and 'severity' values
print('Unique values in arm:', df['arm'].unique())
print('Unique values in severity:', df['severity'].unique())

# Check for case sensitivity or extra whitespace
print('\nUnique values in arm (stripped):', df['arm'].str.strip().unique())
print('Unique values in severity (stripped):', df['severity'].str.strip().unique())

# Check if 'CONTROL' exists in arm column
print('\nDoes "CONTROL" exist in arm? ', 'CONTROL' in df['arm'].values)
print('Does "control" exist in arm? ', 'control' in df['arm'].values)

# Check if 'moderate' exists in severity
print('\nDoes "moderate" exist in severity? ', 'moderate' in df['severity'].values)
print('Does "MODERATE" exist in severity? ', 'MODERATE' in df['severity'].values)"}
